regions.name: Ganges
regions.quote: Type locality is 'ponds and ditches of Bengal', the latter name used historically in reference to a geographical region in the lower Ganges River basin now mostly divided between Bangladesh and the state of West Bengal, India.

regions.name: Sumatra
regions.quote: Ng et al. (1999) noted the presence of small black spots on the body of Indochinese specimens but not those from India and the Greater Sunda Islands, although Tan and Ng (2005) later observed similar patterning on specimens from Jambi province, Sumatra.
